title: Super Miner
description: A modern VeinMiner, TreeChopper, and Excavator plugin for Paper servers with cooldowns, protection support, statistics, GUI menus, and advanced customization.
body:
# SuperMiner

**SuperMiner brings together the most useful survival mining tools into one polished, configurable Paper plugin.**

Designed for SMP servers, SuperMiner helps players spend less time breaking repetitive blocks while preserving balance, durability, and server performance.

## Features
### ⛏️ VeinMiner

Break one ore and mine the entire connected vein.

Supports:

Coal Ore
Iron Ore
Copper Ore
Gold Ore
Redstone Ore
Lapis Ore
Diamond Ore
Emerald Ore
Nether Quartz Ore
Nether Gold Ore
Ancient Debris
Deepslate Variants
### 🌳 TreeChopper

Cut down entire trees by breaking the trunk.

## Features:

Supports all vanilla tree types
Detects leaves before chopping
Protects player-built log structures
Tool durability support
Configurable limits
### 🪓 Excavator

Mine connected dirt-like blocks with a shovel.

Supports:

Dirt
Grass
Gravel
Sand
Clay
Mud
Soul Sand
Snow Blocks
And more
### 📊 Statistics

Track:

Ores mined
Trees chopped
Blocks excavated
Total blocks broken
Time saved
### 🖥️ GUI Menu

Manage:

VeinMiner
TreeChopper
Excavator
Statistics
Settings
### 🔒 Protection Friendly

SuperMiner respects:

WorldGuard
Towny
GriefPrevention
Lands
Other protection plugins
### ⚙️ Highly Configurable

Customize:

Cooldowns
Block limits
Tool requirements
Sounds
Particles
Permissions
World restrictions
Commands
/superminer
/superminer toggle
/superminer menu
/superminer stats
/superminer leaderboard
/superminer reload
Permissions
superminer.use
superminer.veinmine
superminer.treechop
superminer.excavator
superminer.admin
Designed For
Survival SMPs
Community Servers
Economy Servers
Towny Servers
Paper Networks

**SuperMiner was built specifically for modern Paper servers and prioritizes performance, balance, and player experience.**
